description: Rust library for videos from code: scenes as async functions, signals, layout, themes, components, charts, 3D, shaders and sound, checked frame by frame and rendered to MP4 without a browser.
rules: Pin the exact oxframe version: the API changes between minor versions before 1.0.
A scene is `#[oxframe::scene] async fn name(view: View)`; every `.await` on an animation is a frame boundary.
Run `oxframe check` after every change and fix what report.json lists before rendering.
